item.title: North West’s Debut Headlining Tour With Molly Santana Canceled Just Days Before Scheduled Kick-Off: ‘Sadly, It’s Not Happening Anymore’
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update! We've got some news that's sure to disappoint fans of North West and Molly Santana. The duo's highly anticipated co-headlining tour, Molly x North Kimokawaii, has been canceled just days before its scheduled kickoff."
[Soft music transitions]
Host: "The 14-date North American tour was set to launch on August 5th in Dallas and wrap up on August 27th in Los Angeles. The tour was in support of North West's debut EP, NOrth4evr, which dropped in May. Unfortunately, it seems that the shows are no longer happening."
[Short pause]
Host: "According to Ticketmaster and the tour's website, most of the shows have been marked as canceled or are no longer listed. Both North West and Molly Santana have taken to Instagram to address the cancellation. North West wrote that she was 'really excited' to go on tour, but it's no longer happening. Molly Santana apologized to fans, promising to make it up to them soon."
[Outro music starts]
Host: "That's the latest from the music world. We'll keep you updated if we hear any more about what's next for North West and Molly Santana. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
